clues: Two rivers meet in this city, in the heart of North America. Flat prairie land rolls out all around it, far from any sea.
Summers here are hot and sticky, with storms on many afternoons. Winters turn cold and dry, and lows often fall below zero.
A fort rose here in 1843, where the two rivers join. In 1857, this town was picked as the state capital, the second one in its history.
This city is the biggest city in its whole state, and it has held that spot for a long time. It grew up right where its two rivers meet.
The governor of Iowa works in this city. State lawmakers meet here to make laws for all of Iowa.
